text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race was decided. Admire Vega had 
taken 1st place. Standing in the Winner's 
Circle, she savored the warmth and joy 
welling up inside her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next is the final leg of the Classic 
Triple Crown: the Kikuka Sho. After making 
that solemn vow with her rival――

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With excitement in their hearts, summer 
was just around the corner.
